text:
maria_ops: FYI lane cutover from forwarder A -> B caused a partial shipment split. FRA dock got 42/100 units, rest outbound delayed. we have serial gating on the inbound manifest :confused:

alex_vendor: sorry about the split — forwarder had a truck strike, rebooked. AWB for the FRA tranche: `AWB FRA 782-998-01`. ETA now 2024-11-08 14:00 CET (estimated). remaining AWBs are on hold awaiting customs docs.

logistics-bot: auto-update: FRA tranche scanned into customs hold @ 2024-11-07T22:13Z. status=HOLD, reason=missing hs_code declaration.

josh_infra: how many of the received 42 are serial-gated (can't be accepted into pool until test)? we need that number to decide hot-swap allocations.

maria_ops: ACCT team ran quick compare: ~18 are flagged (firmware mismatch / serial gating). 24 cleared.

sophie_ml: if 18 are gated, that reduces our immediate capacity for model serving by roughly 9% on eu-west clusters. we should preemptively move some canary traffic off the affected hosts.

ryan_ops: on RMA — vendor needs to confirm whether gated units can be replaced under DOA or RMA warranty. alex_vendor, can you confirm replacement lead time and whether we get AWB for return? also need RMA labels that work with FRA depot.

alex_vendor: confirmed — gated units qualify for RMA under our DOA policy. replacement ETA from our EU pool: 7-10 business days after RMA acceptance. we will provide prepaid return labels for FRA depot. if customs releases the tranche late we can process RMA remotely (we'll instruct the FRA depot to quarantine & label).

lena_pm: cost question — do we have service credit or price protection for the delayed tranche? vendor, what are options for waive/delay credit?

alex_vendor: options: (1) 5% credit on the tranche invoice for late arrival >72h, (2) expedited replacement at vendor cost share 50/50, or (3) full swap from our EU buffer with no credit but immediate ETA 48-72h. pick one and we’ll action.

maria_ops: leaning to option 3 for service continuity — we can accept buffer swaps if serial-gating won't block them. need confirmation on serial mapping (we can't accept lower-firmware parts).

josh_infra: operational note: if we accept buffer swap, we must update inventory manifests and KV-cache pinning to avoid routing requests to hosts that will be decommissioned. ETA to flip manifests ~1 hour once parts are inbound.

logistics-bot: reminder: to clear customs hold we need HS code + invoice copy. suggested HS code: `8471.30` but forwarder asked for value breakdown per unit.

ryan_ops: I'll upload invoice and per-unit value in production vault and DM the forwarder. also need RMA template with serial map — alex_vendor can you provide CSV with vendor_serial -> replacement_serial mapping when available?

alex_vendor: yes. we'll provide CSV and preprinted return labels. will also include firmware batch notes (which units to avoid).

maria_ops: quick risk call — if customs clears late and we can't swap, we need to schedule a short maintenance window to shed ~10% traffic from eu-west for 2 days. callout to infra teams to prep fallback.

sophie_ml: agree. i'll roll prompt-specific traffic steering rules and metrics to watch. recommend watching tail latency and the error rate for the chat route.

lena_pm: track costs vs credits. i'll log decisions in the procurement ticket and tag finance for potential invoice adjustment.

alex_vendor: will confirm which tranche units are firmware-incompatible by EOD and push the CSV to the shared S3 link.

maria_ops: thanks. next steps: 1) ryan to push invoice + values to forwarder (done by EOD) 2) vendor to share CSV and labels (EOD) 3) infra to prep manifest flip and canary shedding (ETA 1h after replacement notice) 4) pm to track credit option selection. ping if anything slips. :white_check_mark:

logistics-bot: ticket updated: `PROC-1129` — vendor CSV upload pending.

josh_infra: noted. i'll stand by for the replacement manifest and a quick runbook for host eviction.

maria_ops: thanks everyone, will reopen thread if customs clears or if we take option 3.
